children: on Wednesday raised its 2026 revenue growth target to 4-5% from 3-5%, after its third-quarter revenue rose 5% to €1.55 billion ($1.73 billion).
The upgrade, the French software group’s first in two years, signals that a slowdown dating back to 2023 may have bottomed out.
The company, which completed its $1.8 billion purchase of life-sciences software maker ArisGlobal in September, said the deal would add two percentage points to its fourth-quarter growth.
